title: SMTpip: Interpreter-Aware SMT-Based Dependency Conflict Resolution for Restoring Python Source-Code Executability
abstract: arXiv:2608.15886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software developers rely on packages to reuse existing functionality instead of implementing everything from scratch. Python developers commonly provide package and interpreter dependencies using configuration files, such as requirements.txt or setup.py. Package managers in Python, such as pip, can install packages according to dependency and interpreter version constraints specified in configuration files. However, Python dependency resolution remains challenging: (1) different packages may require incompatible versions of the same dependency; (2) dependencies may require a Python interpreter version that is incompatible with the interpreter used for the project, making a valid environment impossible; and (3) pip, the most popular Python package manager, resolves conflicts via backtracking, repeatedly trying candidate versions without knowing whether a valid execution environment exists or not. To address these challenges, we present SM

translated_title: SMTpip：基于解释器感知的SMT依赖冲突解决，用于恢复Python源代码可执行性
translated_abstract: 软件开发人员依赖软件包来复用现有功能，而不是从头实现一切。Python开发者通常使用配置文件（如requirements.txt或setup.py）提供软件包和解释器依赖。Python中的包管理器（如pip）可以根据配置文件中指定的依赖和解释器版本约束来安装软件包。然而，Python依赖解析仍然具有挑战性：（1）不同软件包可能要求同一依赖的不兼容版本；（2）依赖可能要求与项目所用解释器不兼容的Python解释器版本，导致无法形成有效环境；（3）最流行的Python包管理器pip通过回溯来解决冲突，反复尝试候选版本，却不知道是否存在有效的执行环境。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SM。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SMT的依赖冲突解决方法，通过感知解释器约束，有效解决Python依赖解析中的版本冲突和解释器不兼容问题，从而恢复源代码的可执行性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an SMT-based dependency conflict resolution approach that, by being interpreter-aware, effectively addresses version conflicts and interpreter incompatibilities in Python dependency resolution, thereby restoring source-code executability.
